name: Single person, no income — max allotment
description: 1-person household with zero income gets the full max allotment ($298 FY2026).

name: Single person with moderate earnings and rent
description: Passes both income tests; benefit reduced by 30% of net income. Shelter includes rent + utility allowance.

name: Over gross income limit — ineligible
description: Single person with $5000/mo fails the 130% FPL gross test.

name: Elderly member — exempt from gross test, uncapped shelter
description: Elderly household skips gross test; uncapped shelter deduction; medical expenses deductible.

name: Minimum benefit floor for small household
description: 1-person household where calculated benefit is small; min $24 applies (FY2026).

name: Shelter deduction hits cap for non-elderly household
description: Low-income single person with high rent — shelter deduction is capped at $744. Shelter = rent($1500) + SUA($594).

name: Dependent care expenses
description: Single person with earned income and dependent care deduction.

name: Asset test — over limit
description: Single person with assets exceeding the $3000 standard limit.

name: Elderly member gets higher asset limit
description: Elderly member raises asset limit to $4500; $4000 in assets passes the test.

name: Comprehensive — all inputs populated
description: Exercises every scalar input and member field: earned + unearned income, child support exclusion, all shelter components, dependent care, and member assets.

name: Disabled member (not elderly)
description: Disabled member triggers elderly/disabled exemptions: gross test exempt, uncapped shelter, medical deduction, higher asset limit.

name: Categorical eligibility bypasses income and asset tests
description: Household with $5000 income and $10000 in assets is ineligible normally but passes via categorical eligibility.

name: Child support income exclusion
description: Child support paid reduces gross monthly income before the gross income test.

name: Homeless household with flat shelter deduction
description: Homeless household with no rent — shelter deduction uses greater of regular ($298.50) or homeless flat ($198.99).

name: Multiple shelter components add up
description: Tests that rent, taxes, HOA, mortgage, insurance, and utility allowance all contribute to shelter costs.

name: 3-person household with moderate earnings
description: Two working adults + child. Tests multi-member householdSize derivation and 3-person FPL/allotment.

name: 2-person elderly household with medical and uncapped shelter
description: Elderly + non-elderly member. Only the elderly member's medical expenses count. Shelter deduction is uncapped.

name: 5-person household passes gross but fails net
description: 5 members with $3900 unearned income. Passes 130% FPL gross test but exceeds 100% FPL net limit.

name: Student exclusion – non-elderly non-disabled higher-ed student not meeting exceptions
description: A single-member household with a higher-ed student who does not meet any statutory student exemptions should be ineligible for SNAP despite zero income and assets.

name: Pregnant exemption test
description: Single pregnant adult with low income meets eligibility despite low work hours due to pregnancy exemption.

name: ABAWD months exhausted - ineligible
description: Single childless adult who has used all 36 countable months should be ineligible despite meeting other requirements

name: ABAWD parent exemption - eligible
description: Parent with dependent child under 14 should be exempt from ABAWD work requirements even with low work hours

name: ABAWD work hours threshold - just under
description: Single adult working exactly 19 hours per week should not meet ABAWD work requirements (needs 20+ hours)

name: ABAWD work hours threshold - meets requirement
description: Single adult working exactly 20 hours per week should meet ABAWD work requirements

name: ABAWD age exemption - age 17
description: A 17-year-old is ABAWD-exempt but still subject to general work requirements (ages 16-59), so they're ineligible unless they work 30+ hours

name: ABAWD pregnancy exemption
description: Pregnant member is ABAWD-exempt but still subject to general work requirements, so ineligible with only 10 hours of work
